capabilities: Edit .ink files with syntax highlighting and a play panel that recompiles on save
Visualize story structure as a knot graph with unreachable knots highlighted
Save, load and replay playthroughs, including bilingual language switching
Export stories as a self-contained HTML web page
Run solo RPG game mode with dice checks, resources, items, maps and decks
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; makes no network requests; an unofficial fan tool not affiliated with inkle; includes a JSON API for coding agents and a headless batch playtester.
intentEvidence: Think of it as Inky inside your vault
motivation: The author wanted story files, character sheets and outlines in one place, and playtesting without alt-tabbing to Inky or copying files over.
problem: Writing and testing ink stories normally means switching to a separate editor like Inky and moving files, losing the link to the writer's notes and outline.

relations.evidence: Think of it as Inky inside your vault
Stories are compiled and played locally with inkjs

summary: Ink interactive-fiction toolkit that edits, playtests and debugs .ink stories in the vault, with a live play panel, knot graph, saves, bilingual text and web export.
